description: Indefinite-integral advanced technique drills: further u-substitution (exp/log/trig composites), linear-argument trig/exp antiderivatives, trig-power reduction (sin^n, cos^n, product-to-sum), integration by parts (x*e^x, x*trig, x^2*e^x, x^n*ln x), and improper/proper rational-fraction split via partial fractions (including with an unknown-coefficient decomposition step before integrating).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 8: អាំងតេក្រាលមិនកំណត់ (Indefinite Integrals), Sections 8-11: u-substitution, linear-argument, trig products, by-parts, partial fractions — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-29

exercises.technique: u_substitution: recognize u'/u, u'/u^2, u'/\sqrt u forms for exponential, trig, and rational composites
linear_argument_rule and u_substitution: \int f(ax+b)dx=F(ax+b)/a, tan^2/\cot^2 identity rewriting
Trig power-reduction: split odd powers via Pythagorean identity + u-sub, or use product-to-sum formulas for sin(mx)sin(nx)/cos(mx)cos(nx) products

exercises.prompt_latex: \int(x-1)e^x\,dx;\ \int(2x-3)e^{-x}\,dx;\ \int(3x+4)e^{2x}\,dx;\ \int(x-1)\sin x\,dx;\ \int(2x+3)\cos x\,dx;\ \int2x\cos3x\,dx;\ \int(2-3x)\sin2x\,dx;\ \int x\sin(2x-1)\,dx;\ \int(2x-1)\cos(1-x)\,dx;\ \int3\ln x\,dx;\ \int2x\ln x\,dx;\ \int(2-3x)\ln x\,dx;\ \int x^2\ln x\,dx;\ \int x^2e^x\,dx;\ \int x^2\sin x\,dx;\ \int x^2\cos2x\,dx
exercises.technique: integration_by_parts: \int u\,dv=uv-\int v\,du, with u=x/x^2/\ln x and dv=e^x, trig, or polynomial
Partial fraction decomposition: find unknown coefficients (matching numerators) then integrate each term, often with an initial-condition constant
Improper/proper rational-function integral bank: polynomial division (if degree num >= degree denom) then partial fractions; includes a paired-integral trick (solve I+J and I-J simultaneously)
